tenderSchedule.title: Pressure testing, Refilling, repair and rectification of various types of fire extinguishers at Ambikanagar Stores/Garage premises
tenderSchedule.description: 1Transportation of fire extinguisher cylinders from Ambikangar to work site. 2.Hydraulic pressure testing of all the cylinders as per standard testing protocol after emptying of cylinders.3.Refilling of cylinders and replacement of damaged hose, valves or any other spares required.4.Painting and stickering of the cylinders. 5.Handing over of cylinder in good condition along with test certificates to Ambikanagar stores/garage.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer MSPA Office KVP Kali

generalCriterionList.description: Work experience: The prospective bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor at least one similar nature of work of value not less than Rs.0.56 Lakh (exclusive of GST) in any PSUs or Government Dept or Power plant or Reputed organizations in preceding five years i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. In proof of this, bidder should submit a copy of work order and corresponding satisfactory performance / work done certificate issued by competent authority. (In case of state/central Government /Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre and in case of KPCL not below the rank of Chief Engineer) shall be furnished. (Weightage of 10 % per year applicable to previous work orders to bring the current price level of 2026-27).

Annual Turnover:The bidder should have a minimum financial turnover or average annual financial turnover of Rs.1.12 Lakhs in any two financial years from the preceding five financial years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). In proof, the bidder shall upload scanned copies of annual turnover certificate/ profit & loss statement duly certified by chartered accountant. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to bring the current price level of 2026-27).
Bidders shall ensure upload relevant document as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The intending Bidders shall also upload scanned copies of Income Tax PAN along with the tender.
The intending Bidders shall also upload scanned copies of Valid GST registration certificate along with the tender.

Those bidders whose contracts have been terminated / fore-closed by KPCL or whose performance has not been satisfactory while executing the contract within last five years are not eligible to participate in the bid. The bidder shall furnish an undertaking notarized declaration in Rs.200/- non-judicial stamp paper/ self-declaration as per Format-I in this regard. Failing which such bid will not be considered for evaluation.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka.
